known_collateral.purpose: YouTube video and audio media delivery CDN
known_collateral.risk: The suffix is intentionally broad because media hosts are dynamically named. Embedded YouTube playback on unrelated sites is also blocked, and resolved CDN addresses can be shared beyond a single request.
known_collateral.mitigation: Create address rules only from catalog-attributed DNS observations, cap their lifetime, and continuously test non-YouTube Google traffic for collateral damage.

known_collateral.purpose: YouTube thumbnails, player resources, and static assets
known_collateral.risk: YouTube images and player assets embedded by third-party pages disappear even when the containing page is not a YouTube property.
known_collateral.mitigation: Treat this as expected strict-mode collateral and verify that unrelated static Google properties remain reachable.

known_collateral.purpose: YouTube channel avatars, badges, emoji, and related images
known_collateral.risk: ggpht.com is shared Google infrastructure; only the observed YouTube-specific yt3 host is listed, but its resolved addresses may still serve other Google content.
known_collateral.mitigation: Do not widen this rule to ggpht.com or *.ggpht.com, and apply the shared-address safeguards in ip_block_policy.

known_collateral.purpose: Legacy YouTube Data API path on the shared Google APIs host
known_collateral.risk: Blocking the entire www.googleapis.com host would disrupt unrelated Google APIs, while host-only DNS and IP layers cannot distinguish the YouTube path.
known_collateral.mitigation: Keep this rule path-scoped in browser policy and never promote www.googleapis.com to exact_hosts, suffix_hosts, or CNAME-derived IP blocking.

known_collateral.risk: The name is under Google's shared l.google.com infrastructure and its resolved frontend addresses can host more than one Google service.
known_collateral.mitigation: Match only the full YouTube-specific suffix and never generalize the rule to l.google.com or google.com.

known_collateral.purpose: Stop cached or already-established YouTube TCP and QUIC media flows
known_collateral.risk: Address-level enforcement cannot distinguish hostnames that share an IPv4 or IPv6 address, so unrelated traffic to a shared Google edge can be interrupted.
known_collateral.mitigation: Use only target-attributed observations, support both address families and TCP/UDP, expire observations after at most 900 seconds, and remove all owned rules at the lease deadline.
